reviews.title: Most Accurate
reviews.author: DinaYasin
reviews.text: I have used many prayer times Apps before but for sure Nahtadi is the most accurate one of any I have found. It is very user friendly and I like that there are no advertisements nor data gathering.

reviews.title: Best prayer app!
reviews.author: Moodisms
reviews.text: Thank you to the creator of this app that has helped me with keeping up on my prayers and not spamming me with a million ads or collecting my data!!!

reviews.title: Really helpful!
reviews.author: MohamedAB123
reviews.text: Good for traveling both locally and abroad. Very accurate and impressive prayer time calculation methods. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.title: Very unique and helpful app!!
reviews.author: HayaSH-123
reviews.text: Honestly I've used a wide array of Muslim Deen/Prayer apps and this one was very unique. Even while traveling and in Makkah this app was super helpful. I'm very happy with my purchase!

reviews.title: Perfect day-to-day and on-the-go prayer app
reviews.author: tyounis18
reviews.text: Convenient app with no adds, gives you all prayer times for the day for your specific location. Qibla feature is super helpful and reliable as well.

reviews.title: Nahtadi app
reviews.author: Daniaabubaker
reviews.text: Nahtadi app is a very user friendly with clear and clean interface, privacy is maintained as it does not collect your data.
